toolbox-pod.description: Toolbox POD's official hosted MCP server: design custom tees and hoodies, see mockups, and order prints made and shipped from Utah, with a link to pay on toolboxpod.com. Claude pays with the account's card only within a spending limit the account Owner sets; without one it hands over the link. OAuth sign-in: run /mcp, pick toolbox-pod, Authenticate, then sign in or sign up to Toolbox POD. No API key. US addresses only.
